entities.description: A plane of pirates and dinosaurs, revealed to be a hollow world with a Core lit by its sun Chimil.

entities.description: The center of the hollow world of Ixalan.

entities.name: Chimil

entities.name: Cosmium

events.summary: A year after March of the Machine, groups scramble toward Ixalan's center in search of cosmium.
events.quote: Once again, there is a scramble as the groups race toward the center of Ixalan in search of a new resource: cosmium .

events.summary: Past the caves, Ixalan is found to be a hollow world with a Core lit by Chimil.
events.quote: they find that Ixalan is a hollow world with Ixalan's Core in the middle and lit by Chimil , its sun.

events.summary: An ancient civilization uses Chimil's magic to grow in power.
events.quote: An ancient civilization , ancestors of the Sun Empire , uses the magic of Chimil to grow in power.

relations.note: Things changed since the Immortal Sun's disappearance.
relations.quote: Things have changed since the disappearance of the Immortal Sun .
